name: Index Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Index Ventures (indexventures.com), the multi-stage venture firm investing from seed through growth, with offices listed in San Francisco, New York and London (plus Geneva and Jersey on its contact page); registered office Index Ventures (UK) LLP, 5-8 Lower John Street, London. Its July 2026 post marks thirty years of the firm and announces the $400M seed / $900M venture / $2.2B growth funds that match the user-list lead. Its seed line is branded Index Origin (Origin I 2021, Origin II 2022). Not an index-fund or index-tracking asset manager, and not other firms with 'Index' in their name.

values: $2.2B (July 2026: the 2024 growth fund plus a $700M top-up)
conflicts.reason: Index's July 2026 post says the 2024 growth fund was upsized by $700M to $2.2B; recorded as one fund with the 2026 date. New money raised in 2026 is $2.0B, and total investing capital is $3.5B.
Index's figure is more precise; the company's headline looks rounded.
The company's own announcement is dated first.

values: 2026-05-20 (LA Times B2B story 'Revel Secures $150M Series B', listed in Revel's newsroom, not fetchable)
conflicts.reason: Index's post is the earliest dated page found, and its September 2026 profile says the Series B was announced earlier that year.
The title gives $1B; the body's 'million' looks like a typo.

open_items: The formal names of the 2024 venture and growth funds (successors to Index Ventures XI and Growth VI) do not appear on the fetched pages. Index's own 2024 announcement and the BusinessWire, Finextra, Ropes & Gray and Sifted pages returned 403 or 404.
The 2026 $400M seed fund is not named on any fetched page. Whether it is 'Index Origin III' is unconfirmed. Close dates for the 2024 and 2026 funds are announcement dates.

Check size: no firm-wide range is published. Tech.eu (Nov 2022) says Origin II offered 'ticket sizes up to $5 million', but no current seed check size was found, so no check fact is recorded. Recent led seeds range from undisclosed to $71M (Enigma).
No application form, pitch email or apply URL is published. The contact page has only general and media enquiries, so accepts_cold_inbound is unknown.
Indian founders: nothing stated beyond the July 2026 post's line that 'great founders can come from anywhere'. The stated corridor is Tel Aviv to San Francisco.

portfolio_count_reported: the companies page lists several hundred companies without a total. Other figures are partial: Origin I made 32 investments by Nov 2022 (tech.eu), and the 2024 coverage cites 108 or 109 companies that reached a $1B+ valuation.

Robotics and industrial holdings with no round page naming Index: Physical Intelligence (Index company page lists Nina Achadjian and Eryk Dobrushkin, but pi.website has no funding posts), Vizcom (a March 2024 post gives no round details), Phaidra and Motive. All were skipped.
Revel emerged from stealth in April 2025 with $30M in seed and Series A funding. The Index page does not say Index took part, so that round is not recorded.

Co-investors are not named on the fetched pages for Revel, Scope, Build, Ando, Flapping Airplanes or Quilter's Series B. Press confirmation was limited because the web-search budget ran out mid-research.
Stage is not stated for Scope's $20M round. Amount and stage are not stated for Hone or /dev/agents. The amount is not stated for Ando or Build. Index's role is not stated for the Intelligence seed.
Vooma: the Dec 2024 post announces the seed and Series A together. The seed's own date is not given, so both use the post date.
Wonderful's $2B valuation is reported without a pre- or post-money label, so it is left null. The HQ is not stated for Wonderful, Scope, Build, Ando, Hone, Enigma, Intelligence or Quilter.
Titles are not shown on the team pages for Shardul Shah, Bastian Hasslinger or Sahir Azam. TechCrunch (2024) calls Shah a partner. Azam is described as an 'early-stage and growth investor'.
